غِضَابٌ and غُضَابٌ Motes (قَذًى) in the eye: (K, TA:) or, as in one copy of the K, [and in the O,] in the eyes. (TA.) ―
-b2- And A certain disease; (K, TA;) or so the latter word; (O;) an eruption in the skin; but not small-pox: (TA:) or (so accord. to the TA, but in the CK “ and ”) small-pox. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
